newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal sports clubs may convert to companies.
newsitem.headline: Portugal sports clubs may convert to companies.

text.p: The Portuguese cabinet has approved a decree that will give sports clubs the right to convert into companies that distribute dividends to shareholders in line with other European countries, a spokesman said.
The decree, which was expected to come into effect in the coming weeks and will have the force of a law, gives non-profit soccer clubs the right to become profit-maximising concerns.
First division side Lisbon Sporting is the only soccer club in Portugal that has so far voted to convert into a company.
First division soccer clubs must have a minimum capital of 200 million escudos ($1.3 million) and second division clubs 100 million.
Portuguese soccer clubs already owe the Portuguese government millions of dollars in back taxes and social security payments.
